Clans of the Alphane Moon is the canonical works record for PKD's novel. It preserves a single archive manifestation and gives the work a stable bibliographic home. The preserved item here is Clans of the Alphane Moon (1964).

Researchers can use this entry to trace publication context, later commentary, and relationships to other works.
